$comment: T089 — sandbox constraints for the Spec Kit engine container (ADR-0002).
This container runs code the platform did not write, driven by a
non-deterministic AI agent. Every constraint below is the containment for a
specific risk, not defensive decoration:
limits.*        RAID R-02, unbounded AI agent cost. PC-2 cost CONTAINMENT
ships here; optimisation is deferred to M-07.
network.egress  RAID R-06, credential exfiltration and sandbox escape.
user / caps     RAID R-06, privilege escalation inside the container.
One container per job, destroyed after it (E8). Nothing here is a default
to be relaxed under delivery pressure — T089a fails the build if it is.

writableMounts.$comment: The ONLY writable path. Destroyed with the container.

$comment: wallClockSeconds matches the 10-minute job ceiling clarified 2026-08-07 and
recorded in specs/_shared/platform-spec.md. Configurable per deployment;
the value here is the default, and the cap is enforced by the container
runtime as well as by the adapter, so a hung agent cannot outlive it even
if the adapter itself is wedged (E5).

allow.$comment: The AI provider endpoint. The ONLY reachable destination.

$comment: Exhaustive. Whatever is not listed does not exist inside the container:
no DATABASE_URL, no queue URL, no session secret. Built by
src/correlation.ts, which returns exactly these two keys.
PC-3, and the asymmetry is deliberate. The correlation id travels IN as an
environment variable; nothing observable travels OUT. Emitting telemetry
from inside would require widening the egress allow-list above, which is
the one control standing between this container and the open internet.
The WORKER records spans and metrics from outside, on its behalf.
